battlecards.why_selected: Provided retroactive price reduction to 3.15% of collections and locked rate for three years without service disruption.
battlecards.contract_terms: 3-year addendum (retroactive to 9/1/22) at 3.15 % of collections, quarterly tier structure, no‐cause termination still subject to existing early-termination fee (~$9 M).
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Benchmark showed Advantia was paying out-of-market rates; executives threatened issuing RFP 6 months before 2025 expiry.
supplier_strengths: Fully integrated EHR + PM + patient portal
battlecards.switching_costs: High (system migration, provider retraining, data conversion, potential $9 M penalty).
battlecards.notes: Savings scenario 1 based on current $110 M collections delivers full $259 K (slide 5, 10/21/22 update).

battlecards.why_selected: Best BAFO pricing (14 % reduction), ability to service both Mid-Atlantic and Heartland, agreed to 60-day payment terms and inventory/ formulary management.
battlecards.contract_terms: Draft master agreement (Aug–Sept 2022): formulary controls, dedicated resources, QBRs, 60-day terms, multi-year (exact term under review).
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: One enterprise-wide award replacing fragmented distributors; >$1 M annual volume dangled to all bidders.
supplier_weaknesses: Historically limited Heartland presence (mitigated in new deal)
battlecards.switching_costs: Moderate—practice ordering workflows, item cross-referencing, EDI catalogue updates.
battlecards.notes: No distributor change in Mid-Atlantic; Heartland moves from Medline to McKesson 10/31/22 go-live.

battlecards.why_not_selected: Pricing not competitive in BAFO round; could not match McKesson’s formulary and service commitments.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Risk of losing entire Heartland book pushed Medline to two pricing rounds but still higher than McKesson.
supplier_weaknesses: Higher landed cost on core items
battlecards.switching_costs: Minimal—Heartland practices already using dual supplier systems.
battlecards.notes: Remain a potential back-up supplier; provided extensive value-add documentation in RFP response.

battlecards.why_selected: Offered acceptable 10 % reduction without operational disruption; practices preferred to avoid conversion effort.
battlecards.contract_terms: Updated price schedule effective 10/15/22; term aligned with existing service agreements (multi-year).
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Quest’s 16 % cheaper BAFO created credible switch threat.
battlecards.switching_costs: High—system interfaces, staff retraining, specimen pick-up routes.
battlecards.notes: Treya recommended keeping LabCorp if operational change unfeasible; decision accepted.
complexity_reasons: Decision weighed operational change vs. price

battlecards.why_not_selected: Operational disruption (pick-up routes, phlebotomist staffing) outweighed extra 6 % savings vs. LabCorp.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Used as pricing benchmark to push LabCorp BAFO.
supplier_strengths: Best unit pricing on key test panels (up to 33 % savings line-item)
supplier_weaknesses: No embedded staff for several Mid-Atlantic sites
battlecards.notes: Remain strategic alternative for re-bid in future.
complexity_reasons: Offered highest savings but not selected

battlecards.why_not_selected: Per-scan staffing model 20 %+ over market; Advantia opted for in-house recruiting solution.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Cost comparisons showed $140-190 K annual savings from insourcing.
battlecards.switching_costs: Recruiting and onboarding permanent sonographers; temporary coverage during transition.
battlecards.notes: No response to Treya scheduling requests during negotiations.

battlecards.why_not_selected: Chosen only for supplemental (20 %) cover; primary strategy moved to internal recruiter due to long-term cost effectiveness.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Provided cost benchmark to validate internal hiring savings.
supplier_weaknesses: Higher long-term cost than fully in-house team
battlecards.notes: Treya recommends executing side contract for surge needs.

summary.skipped_reason: Suppliers in IUD purchasing, Office Supplies, IT Managed Services, etc. were skipped due to either simple renewals, savings < $50 K, or insufficient strategic detail.
